items.question: How much discount did we give away on completed orders in 2025?
items.sql: SELECT SUM(oi.discount * oi.unit_price * oi.quantity) AS total_discount FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025'
items.answer: The total discount given away on completed orders in 2025 was 693,841.08.

items.question: What was the average completed order value in 2025?
items.sql: SELECT AVG(order_total) AS avg_completed_order_value FROM (SELECT o.order_id, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price * (1.0 - oi.discount)) AS order_total FROM orders AS o JOIN order_items AS oi ON o.order_id = oi.order_id WHERE o.status = 'completed' AND STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY o.order_id) LIMIT 500
items.answer: The average completed order value in 2025 was 2873.06.

items.question: Which region had the highest refund rate on orders in 2025?
items.sql: SELECT r.region_name, COUNT(o.order_id) AS total_orders, SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS refunded_orders, CAST(SUM(CASE WHEN o.status = 'refunded' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS REAL) / COUNT(o.order_id) AS refund_rate FROM orders AS o JOIN customers AS c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id JOIN regions AS r ON c.region_id = r.region_id WHERE STRFTIME('%Y', o.order_date) = '2025' GROUP BY r.region_name ORDER BY refund_rate DESC LIMIT 500
items.answer: LATAM had the highest refund rate on orders in 2025 with a rate of approximately 17.27%. The region recorded 166 refunded orders out of a total of 961 orders.

items.question: Which customer segment filed the most support tickets per customer in 2025?
items.sql: SELECT c.segment, COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS total_tickets, COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS total_customers, CAST(COUNT(t.ticket_id) AS REAL) / COUNT(DISTINCT c.customer_id) AS avg_tickets_per_customer FROM customers AS c JOIN support_tickets AS t ON c.customer_id = t.customer_id WHERE t.created_date >= '2025-01-01' AND t.created_date <= '2025-12-31' GROUP BY c.segment ORDER BY avg_tickets_per_customer DESC LIMIT 500
items.answer: The Enterprise customer segment filed the most support tickets per customer in 2025, with an average of 2.20 tickets per customer.
